{{Quote|We either have to get the transports back to Yellowstrike Spaceport or else maneuver them through the conveyance tunnel maze and find a different way out.|Unidentified Rebel transport captain|<ref name="COO" />}}
This '''transport captain''' served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and was part of the Rebel force sent to the [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]] during a [[Battle for Poln Major|mission]]<ref name="COO" /> in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> When [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]'s [[Eastern Fleet]] arrived in the system, the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] discussed with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] on how the Rebels can evacuate with their [[Starship/Legends|ships]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Minor]].<ref name="COO" />
